full_details: In the morning you looked at Saturday's half-sheet, the king come home to Wales, and added nothing. At the Theatre James said Allen's figure himself. Four-and-twenty pound a year, where the company pays fourteen. Two years less a month. A clause about the house after five years, unexplained. You said a king is coming and that it is long. The curse was not said to Allen's face. Nothing was agreed. You played Navarre. At home the ledger took the thimble at two shillings and sixpence. You wrote no name and no total. The chest was not counted.
one_sentence: James named four-and-twenty pound against fourteen and you agreed nothing, and at home you entered a silver thimble at two shillings and sixpence.
title: Heard four-and-twenty pound and entered a thimble
